אֶרֶץ וְרוּם [וָרוּם] בְּהִבָּרְאָם בְּהֵ"א בְּרָאָם

בִּלְתִּי חֹמֶר יָצַר הָאוֹר [קֹדֶם שְׂאוֹר] בְּרֵאשִׁית הַכֹּל בָּרָא אוֹר
בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בְּשַּׁבָּת [בַּשַּׁבָּת]

בִּלְתִּי עֵזֶר וְיָדַיִם הִבְדִיל [הַמַּבְדִּיל] בֵּין מַיִם לְמַיִם [לָמַיִם]
בְּיוֹם שֵׁנִי בְּשַּׁבָּת [בַּשַּׁבָּת]
חַי חַי חַי

שֶׁתּוֹצִיא הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ גָּזַר אֹמֶר וְכֵן הָיָה
בַּשְׁלִישִׁי בְּשַּׁבָּת [בַּשַּׁבָּת]

לָאוֹר וּלְהַצְמִיחַ פֵּרוֹת גָזַר וְנִתְלוּ מְאוֹרוֹת
בָּרְבִיעִי בְּשַּׁבָּת [בַּשַּׁבָּת]

כָּל נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה הִמְצִיא הוּא כָּל עוֹף כָּנָף לְמִינֵהוּ

בְּיוֹם שִׁשִׁי בְּשַּׁבָּת [בַּשַּׁבָּת]

וַיְקַדֵּשׁ וַיְבָרֶךְ אוֹתוֹ עַל כֵּן יִשְׁמְרוּ עֲדָתוֹ
יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת

יְמַהֵר [מַהֵר] יִבְנֶה [אֶת] הַר צִיּוֹן וְיַנְחִיל עַם דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן
עוֹלָם שֶׁכֻּלּוֹ שַׁבָּת

translation:
Earth and heaven [and heaven] when they were created, with the letter ‘heh’ He created them
Without toil God brought them into being, Lord of the world, Rock of their refuge
Rest on the Sabbath day
Alive, alive, alive
With clean hands and pure, the light of the Enlightened One
Without matter, the light was formed [before dawn] In the beginning, He created light
On a single day on the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Alive, alive, alive
Alone, without a second, He created [made] the heavens
Without aid or hands, He separated [the Separator] between waters and waters [for the waters]
On the second day of the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Living, living, living
God, Creator of worlds, in YHWH He created and it was [Existence]
That the earth should bring forth its fruit, He decreed and so it was
On the third day of the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Alive, alive, alive
Without power, without might, He created lights [the lights]
To give light and to bring forth fruit He decreed, and the lights were set
On the fourth day of the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Alive, alive, alive
Mighty is my God, I will praise Him and exalt Him [exalt Him]
Every living soul He created, every winged bird of its kind
On the fifth day of the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Living, living, living
The Most High God [Alive] decided in His innocence upon the souls [in the souls] of His people
And created man in His image, setting him in charge of all [over all] His world
On the sixth day, on the Sabbath [on the Sabbath]
Living, living, living
My King completed all His work on His Sabbath
And He sanctified and blessed it; therefore shall His congregation
Israel keep the Sabbath
Living, living, living
He is mighty and awesome, the Most High, beyond comprehension
He will hasten [hasten] to build [the] Mount Zion and bequeath it to a poor and destitute people
A world that is entirely Sabbath
Living, living, living
